selected.title: The case still has work
selected.texas_link: Texas is the initial launch market in the June filing. Dallas is current freight context, not a confirmed launch county.
selected.why_today: The latest company update precedes the planned year-end launch and distinguishes claimed readiness from actual driverless highway service.
selected.consequence: Closing the evidence case supports a planned change in who drives the freight truck, while the launch remains prospective.
selected.application_change: The current freight operation is being prepared for a future driverless long-haul launch, with the safety case still unfinished.
selected.counter_image: The unfinished binder remains beside the cab because completion of company evidence is neither crash probability nor a launch announcement.
selected.earned_take: The useful question is what remains unproven before removing the driver, rather than treating a readiness percentage as a safety outcome.

agency.next_step: Kodiak must complete remaining engineering verification and validation toward its stated launch target.
agency.who_can_act: Kodiak engineering and safety teams conduct the remaining work; readers can inspect the company updates. No public comment window identified.
